brief: Marzgah (مرزگاه, 'border post') is the reseller panel for Marzban VPN servers: admins run resellers, resellers serve their customers. The identity should feel Persian, trustworthy and calm — a gatehouse, not a hacker tool.
criteria: Distinct from blue-shield VPN marks, unmistakably Persian without religious symbols, readable at 16 px, works in one colour and RTL.

concepts.name: Iwan — the border gate
concepts.idea: A Persian iwan portal set into a border line; the line breaks only where the gate opens.
rationale: Says the name: a gate (gāh) in a border (marz)
Caravanserai architecture — Persian, secular, built for travellers
Turquoise and lapis from Isfahan's tilework, not VPN blue

recommendation: Iwan — approved direction. Turquoise mark, lapis wordmark, Arad + Poppins.
next_steps: Wire the favicon and logo into the panel
Trademark search in Iran and target markets
Custom refinement pass on the Persian wordmark
